title: Changing data: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
explanation: So far you've only READ data. Now you'll change it! INSERT INTO adds new rows. UPDATE changes values in rows that already exist. DELETE FROM removes rows. Important: UPDATE and DELETE almost always need a WHERE. Without it, they change EVERY row in the table, and there's no undo button! Pro tip: before you UPDATE or DELETE, run a SELECT with the same WHERE first, to see exactly which rows you'll hit. Don't worry, practice data here resets for every task.

example.code:
INSERT INTO studios (studio_id, studio_name, country, founded_year)
VALUES (13, 'Team Cherry', 'Australia', 2014);

lines.line: INSERT INTO studios (studio_id, studio_name, country, founded_year)
lines.explain: Add a new row to the studios table. The brackets list which columns you're filling in, in order.
The values for the new row, in the same order as the columns. Text goes in single quotes.

tasks.prompt: Add a new player: ID 11, username NovaStar, from Australia, signed up on 2026-10-20, with 0 hours played.
hints: Use INSERT INTO players VALUES ( ... ), with the values in the same order as the table's columns.

solution_lines.explain: Add a new row to the players table.
Fill in every column, in the table's order: ID, username, country, sign-up date, hours. Text and dates go in quotes.

tasks.prompt: Stardew Valley is on sale! Change its price to 9.99.
tasks.answer: UPDATE games SET price = 9.99 WHERE title = 'Stardew Valley';
hints: UPDATE the table, SET the new value, and use WHERE so only Stardew Valley changes.
UPDATE games SET price = 9.99 WHERE title = 'Stardew Valley';

solution_lines.explain: Change data in the games table.
Only for Stardew Valley. Without this line, EVERY game would become 9.99!

tasks.prompt: Give every game that has no rating a rating of 8.5.
tasks.answer: UPDATE games SET rating = 8.5 WHERE rating IS NULL;
hints: Remember Lesson 5: missing values are found with IS NULL, not = NULL.
UPDATE games SET rating = 8.5 WHERE rating IS NULL;

solution_lines.explain: Change data in the games table.
Only for games whose rating is missing. That's EA Sports FC 24 and Valorant.

tasks.prompt: Delete every sale that happened before 2022.
hints: Dates are text in year-month-day order, so you can compare them with < just like numbers.

solution_lines.explain: Remove rows from the sales table.
Only rows with a sale date before January 1st, 2022. That removes 3 sales from 2021.

tasks.prompt: Predict first: what happens when you run this? (There's no WHERE!)
hints: WHERE is what picks which rows to delete. What if nothing picks?
With no WHERE, DELETE doesn't ask questions. It hits every row.

solution_lines.explain: No WHERE means no filter, so ALL 13 sales are wiped. In a real company database, this is how disasters happen. Always double-check your WHERE!

recap: You just learned to add rows with INSERT, change them with UPDATE, and remove them with DELETE. Golden rule: UPDATE and DELETE always need a WHERE, and SELECT first to check.
